page.overview:
Who is Chalteaufite?

Chalteaufite is a character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is the member of the Passage of the Unbound who stole the Steelhog Vessel. Chalteaufite is the antagonist during the Physical Ranged DPS role quests in the Dawntrail expansion.

Chalteaufite was one of Apyaahi's guests who joined her villainous group, the Passage of the Unbound. Apyaahi revealed the existence of sacred artifacts around Tural. These artifacts contain the essence of fearsome beasts called Tural Vidraal, and said that with the power of the artifacts they could achieve their goal..}} Following Apyaahi's instructions, Chalteaufite disguised himself as a merchant and infiltrated a village in the south of Yok Tural. Chalteaufite attracted the attention of the villagers by displaying exotic goods from foreign lands and serving them free drinks. Under cover of night, Chalteaufite stole the Steelhog Vessel and fled back to Ala Mhigo. Following the trail of an empty bottle Chalteaufite left behind, Ceetol Ja was able to follow him to Gyr Abania in an attempt to recover the treasure..|name=To Steal a Steelhog}}

Using the powers of the Steelhog Vessel, Chalteaufite deceived several poor citizens of Ul'dah and made promises of change. Chalteaufite gathered a group of subordinates and forced them to join him in attacks. The followers quickly became disillusioned, although their attempts to protest were met with threats and violence by Chalteaufite. At one point, Chalteaufite recruited a Mamool Ja mercenary called Kaqool Ja. Chalteaufite told Kaqool Ja that the cost of a ship back to Tural was enough to buy a mansion in Eorzea, and said that if the mercenary served him loyally, Chalteaufite would cover all the costs of his journey home..}}

Using the vessel's power, Chalteaufite began attacking trade caravans coming from Gridania, claiming that the merchants were overworking and underpaying their workers and therefore deserved to be plundered..|name=Bandits Abound}} As Chalteaufite's gang attacked a merchant and his escort, the Warrior of Light arrived to help the victims. Chalteaufite used the Steelhog Vessel's power on Kaqool Ja and ordered him to deal with the Warrior of Light. Just as Kaqool Ja drew his axe, Ceetol Ja arrived on the scene. Upon seeing a compatriot, Kaqool Ja refused to fight and put away his weapon. Ceetol Ja asked Chalteaufite to return the treasure, but he refused, saying that only he would know how to harness the Vessel's power. While Chalteaufite fled, Ceetol Ja took the wounded to Rhalgr's Reach.
